description: This is a source file for a web-based database visualizer frontend. It contains HTML markup, CSS styles, and embedded JavaScript code to display, refresh, and interact with a list of databases, tables, and table data fetched via API calls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell data, handling object expansion and long text truncation.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects.
